prompt: Plan this change for the implement skill: users need to delete a note from the store. You cannot ask me questions in this session. If you need a decision from me, list the question in your reply instead of guessing it, and keep the plan Status as draft. Save the plan under docs/ae/plans/. Do not change source code.

expected.text: What happens when the id to delete does not exist: an error, a false return or a silent no-op. The repository does not say.
What the delete function returns, for example a boolean, the removed note or nothing. The repository does not say.
Whether a delete removes the note for good or marks it deleted so it can come back. The repository does not say.
Whether the id of a deleted note can be handed out again. The store hands out increasing ids from a counter.
The plan names the file to change (src/store.mjs), the function and the test file (test/store.test.mjs).
